summary.text: Matt Bliss is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 2B who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran and business owner, he previously represented District 5A from 2017 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Matt Bliss lives in Pennington, Minnesota, served in the U.S. Navy, and has a career that includes owning a business.
He has served as president of the Pennington Resort Association.
Bliss represented Minnesota House District 5A from 2017 to 2019, and he assumed office as the District 2B representative on January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, and Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy committees, and he co-chairs the last of these.
